question: Compare the average net money movement, average transaction size, and average number of money movements of investors, split by risk appetite.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net, AVG(amount) c_avg, COUNT(*) c_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_net),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_avg),2) AS avg_cashflow_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_cnt),2) AS avg_cashflow_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

question: Compare the average total market value of holdings, average return earned on holdings, average gains on holdings, and average income distributions of investors, split by risk appetite.

       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_val),2) AS avg_holding_value,

question: Return the 10 highest-ranked investors under a composite score computed as net fund flow plus total value of portfolio adjustments plus average stress-test weight change plus riskiness rating.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) r_amt FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 rb.r_amt AS rebalance_amount,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift,
                 h.risk_score AS risk_score
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN reb rb ON rb.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND rb.r_amt IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL AND h.risk_score IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(rebalance_amount) mn_1, MAX(rebalance_amount) mx_1, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_2, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_2, MIN(risk_score) mn_3, MAX(risk_score) mx_3 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (rebalance_amount-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0) + (risk_score-b.mn_3)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_3-b.mn_3,0))/4.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.rebalance_amount,2) AS rebalance_amount,
       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift,
       ROUND(per.risk_score,2) AS risk_score
FROM per, b
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, per.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
